title: Organisational psychology
learning_outcomes: Explain motivation and incentives in the context of organisational psychology.
Compare and distinguish role conflict in the context of organisational psychology.
Apply culture measurement in the context of organisational psychology.
Evaluate and justify decisions about intervention in the context of organisational psychology.

lessons.title: Motivation and incentives
lessons.outcome: Explain motivation and incentives in the context of organisational psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving motivation and incentives; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to organisation case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain motivation and incentives from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of motivation and incentives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Role conflict
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish role conflict in the context of organisational psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving role conflict; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to organisation case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain role conflict from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of role conflict; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Culture measurement
lessons.outcome: Apply culture measurement in the context of organisational psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving culture measurement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to organisation case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain culture measurement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of culture measurement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Intervention
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about intervention in the context of organisational psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving intervention; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to organisation case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain intervention from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of intervention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of motivation and incentives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of role conflict; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of culture measurement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of intervention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
